script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: ECHOES IN THE WIND

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

*Two WOMEN, LUCY and MAYA, sit across from each other, chatting as they sip their coffee.*

LUCY: (laughs) And then he just walked out of the room! I couldn't believe it.

MAYA: (smiling) Oh, Lucy. You always know how to make me laugh.

*A moment of silence passes between them, as they share a look.*

LUCY: (serious) But really, I don't know what to do. I feel so lost.

MAYA: (reassuring) You'll figure it out. You always do.

*As they continue their conversation, a man, ALEX, enters the coffee shop. He walks over to their table, a small bouquet of wildflowers in hand.*

ALEX: (excited) Lucy! Maya! I saw you both here and just had to come over and say hi.

LUCY: (surprised) Alex! It's so good to see you.

MAYA: (smiling) Welcome!

*Alex sits down at their table and they all chat for a while. Lucy shares more stories about her recent romantic struggles, and Alex offers words of encouragement.*

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

*Lucy, Maya, and Alex are walking along a scenic country road, taking in the beautiful scenery. They laugh and share stories, enjoying each other's company.*

MAYA: (pointing to a tree) Do you remember this tree? We used to come here all the time when we were kids.

LUCY: (nods) Yes, I do. It's amazing how time flies.

ALEX: (sighs) It really is.

*They walk in silence for a moment, each lost in their thoughts.*

LUCY: (looking at Maya) You know, I don't think I could have gotten through all of this without you two.

MAYA: (smiling) And I wouldn't want to go through it with anyone else.

ALEX: (agrees) We make a great team.

*They continue walking, their friendship stronger than ever.*

INT. LUCY'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

*Lucy is packing up some of her belongings, preparing to move out of her apartment. Maya and Alex are helping her, offering words of support and encouragement.*

MAYA: (teary-eyed) I'm going to miss this place.

ALEX: (reassuring) We'll make new memories, I promise.

*Lucy looks around her apartment, taking in the memories one last time before they all head out into the night.*

EXT. SIDEWALK - NIGHT

*The three friends walk down the sidewalk, holding hands and laughing. They share stories and make plans for the future.*

LUCY: (looking at Maya and Alex) I'm so grateful for both of you.

MAYA: (smiling) And we're grateful for you, Lucy.

ALEX: (agrees) We'll always be here for each other.

*They continue walking, their friendship a beacon of light in the darkness.*

FADE OUT.

---

THE END
